name: Google Stitch
tagline: Generates user interfaces for mobile and web apps from a prompt or a sketch.
about: Stitch is a Google tool for interface design. Describe a screen or upload a sketch and it produces a design you can refine and export.
pros: Generates screens from a prompt or an uploaded sketch.
cons: An experimental product, so features can change.
Output is a starting point, not a finished design system.
